verdict: Recorded arithmetic and controls pass; supports logical pose retiming with a latency/CPU tradeoff, not a higher-frame-rate or physical-user-feel claim.
caveats: Four serial runs per condition on one machine; per-frame observations are not independent experimental replicates.
Synthetic phase/timestamp metadata replay through GPUI; logical prepaint poses are not raster displacement or a physical trackpad/user-feel trial.
The algorithm deliberately uses12.5ms sample lookback. Source-equivalent displayed-pose lag is a compound modeled surrogate, not a physical end-to-end latency measurement.
Core frame cadence did not improve; sparse held logical pose pairs disappeared, a narrower objective finding.
The0/12.5ms source-normalized curve residuals are mixed across pairs; do not claim universal uneven-step improvement from held-pose counts.
Whole-GPU model watts include WindowServer/desktop work, are not app watts or total system/battery power, and use a broader window than primary motion cores.
CPU increases in all four adjacent pairs; app GPU execution-time contrasts are mixed; lower shared GPU modeled watts do not establish lower total energy or equal-output efficiency.
Successful pilots and retained failed On pilot are excluded. Normal activation after readiness was fixed identically for both main conditions before main acquisition.
Endpoint unknown-handling was corrected during acquisition without reading main results, preserving prior code/patch/test evidence; all actual final endpoints in this dataset are known.
